extraction_notes: Target identity is AO3415A, manufacturer UMW Youtai Semiconductor Co Ltd, and the supplied PDF title and page headers identify UMW AO3415A.
P-channel voltage and current values retain the datasheet signed convention: VDS, VGS, ID, VGS(th), V(BR)DSS, and VSD are negative; capacitance and resistance values remain positive.
The threshold row publishes MIN = -0.3 V, TYP = -0.56 V, and MAX = -1 V at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 uA, TA = 25 degC.

RDS(ON) is published at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -4 A as TYP = 34 mOhm and MAX = 36 mOhm, and at VGS = -2.5 V, ID = -4 A as TYP = 43 mOhm and MAX = 60 mOhm. The table specifies pulse test width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2%.
Ciss = 1450 pF, Coss = 205 pF, and Crss = 160 pF are typical values at VDS = -10 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz; note 3 states these parameters have no way to verify.

IDSS is limited to -1 uA at VDS = -16 V and VGS = 0 V. IGSS is limited to +/-10 uA at VDS = 0 V, VGS = +/-8 V and +/-1 uA at VDS = 0 V, VGS = +/-4.5 V. These leakage fields are not present in the strict MOSFET schema.

The absolute-maximum table gives VDS = -20 V, VGS = +/-8 V, continuous ID = -5 A for t <= 10 s, PD = 1 W for t <= 10 s, TJ = 150 degC, RthetaJA = 357 degC/W, and TSTG = -55 to +150 degC. Unsupported absolute-maximum fields are not added outside the strict schema.

The switching table publishes Rg = 6.5 ohm at VDS = 0 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz; Qg = 17.2 nC, Qgs = 1.3 nC, and Qgd = 4.5 nC at VDS = -10 V, VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -4 A. These fields are not present in the strict MOSFET schema.
Figures 1, 2, 6, and 8 contain usable typical curves; listed points are compact direct readings from the plotted traces and are not interpolated.
The supplied datasheet date is Nov. 2024 and no separate revision identifier is stated.
